true_answer: 0.3. Sets 29 Example 0.3.3 Let A | { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 } , B | { 2 , 4 , 6 } , C | { 1 , 2 , 3 } and D | { 7 , 8 , 9 } . Determine which of the following are true, false, or meaningless. 1. A ⊂ B . 2. B ⊂ A . 3. B ∈ C . 4. ∅∈ A . 5. ∅ ⊂ A . 6. A < D . 7. 3 ∈ C . 8. 3 ⊂ C . 9. { 3 } ⊂ C . Solution . 1. False. For example, 1 ∈ A but 1 < B . 2. True. Every element in B is an element in A . 3. False. The elements in C are 1, 2, and 3. The set B is not equal to 1, 2, or 3. 4. False. A has exactly 6 elements, and none of them are the empty set. 5. True.
